MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

2. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

4. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 10

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 4

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 22
   C. 77
   D. 36

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 13

16. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

17. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

18. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

21. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 30
   D. 44

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
